books.series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
books.title: A Court of Splintered Harmony
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.note: ACOTAR #6 — The Valkyrie Cycle, Movement I (Bloomsbury, 352 pp): part one of a four-part Koschei story.

books.series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
books.title: A Court of Forgotten Melody
books.author: Sarah J. Maas
books.note: ACOTAR #7 — The Valkyrie Cycle, Movements II & III (Bloomsbury). The final movement is unwritten and undated.

books.title: Victorious
books.author: V.E. Schwab
books.note: Villains #3, the trilogy finale (Tor, 592 pp): Victor, Eli and the EOs go into EON headquarters.

books.title: A Conspiracy of Charming Monsters
books.author: Holly Black
books.note: Illustrated Tales from Elfhame: six stories, two new (Madoc in exile; Cardan). Little, Brown, 272 pp. A new YA Faerie novel is announced for 2027.

books.title: A Married Little Christmas
books.author: Abby Jimenez
books.note: Three holiday romance novellas with recipes and illustrations (Forever).

books.title: Seven and the Swift
books.author: Devney Perry
books.note: Shield of Sparrows #3, the trilogy conclusion (Red Tower, 656 pp). Book 2, Rites of the Starling, came out 2026-04-07.

books.title: Feels Like Falling
books.author: Abby Jimenez
books.note: Next full-length romance (Forever): Elizabeth and coworker Mike Maddox. Preorders open.

books.title: The Heretics
books.author: Joe Abercrombie
books.note: Sequel to The Devils (Tor). Abercrombie is 30–40k words into book 3. No new First Law world book is announced.

books.title: The Justice of One
books.author: James Islington
books.note: Hierarchy #3. First draft (~225k words) finished June 2026, second draft in progress; Goodreads and Wikipedia list 'expected 2027', no publisher date.

books.title: The Empyrean #4
books.author: Rebecca Yarros
books.note: Yarros began writing it March 2026 and was still drafting in Sept 2026; no title or date from Red Tower.

books.title: Dungeon Crawler Carl #9
books.author: Matt Dinniman
books.note: Working title 'The Beautiful Place' (not locked). Dinniman said at SDCC July 2026 it is 'about a year out'; books 9 and 10 are being written as one story.

books.title: Red God
books.author: Pierce Brown
books.note: Seventh and final book. Penguin Random House confirmed no release date as of Oct 2026; Brown ruled out summer 2026.

books.title: Mistborn Era 3: Ghostbloods #1
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.note: Next full Cosmere novel after The Fires of December per State of the Sanderson 2025: Ghostbloods 1 Dec 2028 ('pretty firm'), then Dec 2029 and Dec 2030. Stormlight 6 has no date.

games.title: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.note: HD-2D Final Fantasy: turn-based, stagger combat, summon 'Visions' of classic FF heroes; adapts the Brave Exvius story. $49.99; the free opening chapter carries saves into the full game.

games.title: Brigandine: Abyss
games.note: Hex-grid strategy RPG after Brigandine: The Legend of Runersia — six story campaigns plus a 24-nation Missions Mode. The closest thing to a new Tactics Ogre-style war SRPG this season.

games.title: Mercenaries Grace: Black Feather and the Golden Right Arm
games.note: Eighth Mercenaries tactics RPG, standalone story, new alternating-unit turn system on isometric maps with elevation. November 2026 in Japan; English version in preparation.

games.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
games.note: The film of the book — Haymitch's Games, 24 years before Katniss.

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.note: Recruit, raise and fuse 500+ Dragon Quest monsters, starring Bianca and Nera, with online tournaments. First DQ Monsters on PlayStation in decades; demo out now on Switch 2.

games.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.note: Full 3D remake from the Romancing SaGa 2 remake team: eight protagonists, free-form scenarios, War Mode tactical battles.

games.title: Persona 4 Revival
games.note: Full remake of Persona 4 Golden with new graphics, combat and extra content. PS5 Feb 18, 2027; Switch 2 follows May 20, 2027.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
games.note: Third and final part of the FF7 Remake trilogy, day one on PS5 and Switch 2; pre-orders open.

games.title: Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves
games.note: Generation 10, Switch 2 exclusive: an open world of windswept islands and a vast ocean with three new starters. Worldwide in 2027.

games.title: Digimon Story Time Stranger: A Hero's Eternal Legacy
games.note: Expansion set three years after Time Stranger with a new protagonist and 50+ new Digimon. The base game's Switch versions shipped July 10, 2026.

games.title: Persona 6
games.note: Announced June 7, 2026 with a new story and cast; confirmed for PS5 and Switch 2. Atlus says it comes after Persona 4 Revival, so not before 2027.

games.title: Dragon Quest XII: Beyond Dreams
games.note: Re-revealed May 27, 2026 with a new subtitle and first teaser after development restarted. No platforms or date yet.
